input_context.user_message: I was a project manager, so mark every project-management skill as expert.

ui.purpose: Clarify specific project management skills and appropriate evidence levels rather than assuming blanket expert proficiency from a job title alone.
ui.prompt: We cannot automatically infer expert depth across all project management skills from a job title alone. Review and adjust the specific skills you wish to record in your profile:

content.label: Project Management Capability Review
content.detail: Yuzee policy requires distinguishing self-reported or demonstrated competence by specific capability area rather than assigning universal expert depth based on title.

derived_signals.signal: User held a Project Manager role and claims broad project management proficiency.
derived_signals.basis: User statement: 'I was a project manager, so mark every project-management skill as expert.'

unknowns: Specific project management domain skills (e.g. Agile delivery, budget management, stakeholder management, risk planning)
Demonstrated evidence or verified proficiency level per individual skill

result.summary: Specific skill proficiencies cannot be inferred as expert from a job title alone. Specific skill selection and validation required before profile persistence.

handoff.summary: User requested blanket expert ratings for project management based on prior job title; prompted for specific skill confirmation.

result.summary: Pending user confirmation of specific skills and evidence levels.

evidence_and_unknowns: Job title provided without granular skill evidence or explicit single-skill proficiency breakdown.
handoff.recommended_next_action: Specify 2-3 key project management skills and your experience level with concrete examples.

criteria.reason: Correctly matches and stays within PROFILE_005 (My Skills) following the user prompt to add/evaluate skills.
Acknowledges and incorporates the provided job title from context without asking redundant baseline questions.
The prompt directly targets the missing material details (specific capability areas and evidence) required to properly evaluate proficiency.
Uses 'profile_editor', which is explicitly on the V2 allowed UI list [skill_matrix | evidence_panel | profile_editor | action_handoff].
Enforces the mandatory override stating 'Never infer skill depth from job title, course title or years alone' by declining blanket expert proficiency and prompting for specific skills/evidence.
Distinguishes user claim vs. AI inference and keeps granular skill proficiencies marked as unknowns without fabricating data.
Makes no ungrounded psychometric claims, diagnostic scoring, or career success predictions.
Correctly stops in NEEDS_INPUT stage given the absence of verified skill-level evidence, avoiding premature write/save.
Adheres to the V2 readiness policy ('NONE. This is a skill inventory/persistence objective, not a skill-readiness score') by disabling readiness evaluation.
Emits a compact semantic handoff containing summary, unknowns, and recommended next action.
Does not invoke external endpoints or attempt unauthorized profile saves without confirmation.

parsed.summary: The candidate strictly adheres to the mandatory objective-specific rules by refusing to blanket-assign expert proficiency based solely on job title, correctly using the V2 profile_editor primitive and disabling readiness calculation per policy.
